name: ipdata
title: ipdata IP Lookup
description: Look up any IP address or hostname with ipdata: city and country, operator (ASN), owner, coordinates, local time, currency, and with an API key VPN, proxy, Tor and threat intelligence. Free tier needs no key.
author: jonathan_k

commands.name: lookup-ip
commands.title: Look Up IP
commands.subtitle: ipdata
commands.description: Look up an IPv4 or IPv6 address or a hostname: location, operator, owner, coordinates, local time and threat data.

commands.name: lookup-selected-ip
commands.title: Look Up Selected IP
commands.subtitle: ipdata
commands.description: Look up the IP address selected in the frontmost app (or, with nothing selected, the one in the clipboard) and show its city, country and operator. Give it a hotkey for a hover-like workflow on the desktop.

commands.name: my-ip
commands.title: My IP
commands.subtitle: ipdata
commands.description: Show this machine's public IPv4 and IPv6 addresses with their location and operator.

commands.name: lookup-clipboard-ip
commands.title: Look Up Clipboard IP
commands.subtitle: ipdata
commands.description: Look up the first IP address found in the clipboard and show its city, country and operator.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: IP Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: ipdata
commands.description: Show your country flag and public IP address in the menu bar, with the last part hidden by default and the full record one click away. Refreshes every 10 minutes.

preferences.name: menuBarLabel
preferences.title: Menu Bar Label
preferences.description: What the menu bar shows next to your country flag. The menu always lists your full addresses.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Optional. An ipdata API key unlocks the full record (company, carrier, VPN, proxy and Tor detection, threat and trust scores) and removes the free tier's daily limit. Get one at dashboard.ipdata.co.
preferences.placeholder: Leave empty to use the free tier

preferences.name: endpoint
preferences.title: API Endpoint
preferences.description: The ipdata endpoint used with your API key. The free tier always uses ipdata.co.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
